name: Middle East
description: Follow Middle East, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Pressure on global chokepoints drives Asia's increased use of Arctic Trade Routes
changes.summary: Asian nations began pilot voyages over a decade ago to find routes to Europe and the Middle East that were faster and less vulnerable to chokepoints. The ongoing war has added impetus to those efforts. (Image credit: Jung Yeon-Je).

changes.title: Expert: Images of damaged U.S. bases in Middle East show Iran "getting help from Russia and China"
changes.summary: CBS News has exclusively gained access to photos that show widespread damage at U.S. bases in the Middle East as a result of the war with Iran. Former Defense Department official Matthew Kroenig joins "The Takeout" with his reaction.

changes.title: How Sept. 11 Paved the Way to Mideast Power for Iran
changes.summary: The American invasion of Iraq in 2003 set the path for Tehran to dominate its neighbor and whetted its appetite to expand its influence across the greater Middle East.

changes.title: In a Signal to Trump, Beijing Hosts Iranian Diplomat Ahead of U.S.-China Summit
changes.summary: China renewed calls for an end to the fighting in the Middle East while demonstrating its influence over Tehran.

changes.title: As Oil Prices Rise, BRICS Leaders Have What U.S. Doesn’t: Iran at the Table
changes.summary: The group, which includes Iran, has been split over the war. It called for “maximum restraint” in the Middle East without casting blame on any particular country.

changes.title: On board a warship headed to support the war in Iran
changes.summary: The USS George Washington was deployed to New York after the 9/11 attacks. Now, the aircraft carrier is headed to the Middle East to support President Trump's war against Iran. Tom Hanson is on board with a new report.

changes.title: BRICS leaders voice concern over Middle East, condemn unilateral sanctions at India summit
changes.summary: The meeting, which included Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, voiced concern over "deliberate attacks" on civilian infrastructure and peaceful nuclear facilities under the U.N. atomic energy agency's safeguards.

changes.title: Why Mokha, Historic Port That Shaped the Coffee Trade, Is a Prize in Yemen’s War
changes.summary: A strategic location on the Red Sea afforded the city centuries of trading dominance — and makes it a coveted target in today’s fighting in the Middle East.

changes.title: As Oil Prices Rise, BRICS Leaders Have What U.S. Doesn’t: Iran at the Table
changes.summary: Even so, finding unity among the loose grouping of emerging economies will be difficult as the war in the Middle East strains their own interests.
